Tess (People Ops): Lee submitted an ADA accommodation request for reduced evening hours for 8 weeks due to medication side effects. Looping in Omar for scheduling.

Omar (Manager): Thanks. Which evenings specifically? We have two late demos on Wednesdays and Thursdays.

Lee (Employee): Evenings Mon/Wed/Thu after 6pm are hard right now. Requesting to end day by 5:30pm on those days. Happy to make up time earlier or on Friday.

Tess (People Ops): That's reasonable. We can provisionally approve for 8 weeks with a provider note uploaded to the portal. Keep details private.

Omar (Manager): OK - I'll shift the Wednesday demo to Alex and ask the Thursday client to move to afternoon. Lee, please add preferred makeup windows and we'll update the rota.

Lee (Employee): I'll add 8:30-11:30 mornings Tue/Fri as make-up. Thanks so much. :relieved:

hr-bot: Reminder - please upload medical note here: https://redwood.company/handbook/accommodations (secure portal).

Tess (People Ops): Manager checklist dropped: 
- provisional_start: YYYY-MM-DD
- provisional_end: YYYY-MM-DD (<= 8 weeks)
- schedule_summary: end by 17:30 M/W/Th; make-up windows specified
- documentation: provider note upload
- checkins: weekly 15m with manager to confirm coverage
- perf_note: annotate accommodation context in calibration docs

Omar (Manager): I'll update calendar and standup notes. Thanks all.

Lee (Employee): Uploaded the note and confirmed morning windows. Appreciate the support.
